rationale: VERSION 2.1.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced the single non-self-touching corridor with constructive branching route networks that exercise the executable rule's actual path-selection semantics.; Added a unique_shortest lesson family in which one color-7 obstacle disables the direct route and a second disables one equal detour, leaving a unique legal shortest detour. Removing obstacle influence selects a different, shorter route.; Added a fewest_turns lesson family in which a color-7 obstacle disables the direct route and leaves two equal-length legal detours with different turn counts. The uniquely straighter detour is selected.; Added a calibrated 12% default-only prior over all four distinct public input morphologies. Lawful D4 transforms and independent zero padding vary nuisance orientation and position without changing the route decision.; Removed six inert, redundant, and poison controls plus four advertised degenerate textures. The sole answer-bearing axis is now selection_mode=unique_shortest|fewest_turns.; Added strict call validation, returned-grid self_check, observe_overrides, a total Python rule mirror, a strict public-profile predicate, deterministic keyed construction, fresh returns, and canonical RULE_HASH pinning.; Added eleven focused regression groups covering both canonical rows and all eight normalized pairs, stable profile coverage, both exact modes, obstacle causality, fewest-turn ties, D4/padding metamorphisms, strict overrides, provenance, source synchronization, determinism, freshness, global RNG isolation, and destructive mutations.; Added an independent 30000-draw main/stability census, a git-source reconstruction of version 2.1, and a 497-case live Racket parity audit spanning public, generated, profile, axis, no-obstacle, missing-marker, disconnected, extra-obstacle, simple-corridor, and three-marker cases.
summary: Read the first two color-9 cells in reading order as endpoints. A cell is walkable when it is color 9, or when it is color 8 and no cardinal neighbor is color 7. Among simple legal paths between the endpoints, choose the path with the fewest cells and then the fewest direction changes. Paint every cell of that selected path color 9 while preserving obstacles, blocked cells, unused route branches, and background.
